name: long-task
description: A goal too big for one context, built feature by feature: an initializer writes a prioritised feature list with end-to-end checks, then fresh agents build and verify one feature each (quality gates after every one) until all pass, then a final review. Resumable at any point.

goal.description: What to build, in as much detail as you have.

constraints.description: Stack, libraries, style or anything else to respect
constraints.default: use the project's existing stack, or a simple standard one

init.title: Plan the features

lock.title: Freeze the feature list
lock.command: mkdir -p .harness/long-task && cp .harness/long-task/features.json .harness/long-task/features.lock.json && (git add -A && git -c user.name=agent -c user.email=agent@harness.invalid commit -q -m 'long-task: plan' || true)

check.title: Features left?
check.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='.harness/long-task/';let a,b;try{a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(d+'features.json','utf8'))}catch(e){console.log('features.json is missing or not valid JSON: '+e.message);process.exit(2)}if(!Array.isArray(a)||!a.length){console.log('features.json must be a non-empty JSON array');process.exit(2)}try{b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(d+'features.lock.json','utf8'))}catch{b=null}const strip=x=>JSON.stringify(x.map(({passes,...r})=>r));if(b&&strip(a)!==strip(b)){console.log('features.json was changed beyond its passes fields: restore every id, description and step from git and only flip passes');process.exit(3)}const left=a.filter(x=>x.passes!==true);const passing=a.length-left.length;let st={passing:-1,stalls:0};try{st=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(d+'.state.json','utf8'))}catch{}if(passing>st.passing)st.unsticks=0;st.stalls=left.length&&passing<=st.passing?st.stalls+1:0;st.passing=passing;fs.writeFileSync(d+'.state.json',JSON.stringify(st));console.log(passing+'/'+a.length+' features pass'+(left.length?'. Next: '+left[0].id+' - '+left[0].description:''));if(st.stalls>=3){console.log('No feature has passed in the last 3 sessions.');process.exit(4)}process.exit(left.length?1:0)"

build.title: Build the next feature
build.prompt:
You are one session of a long task; earlier sessions' work is in the workspace.

1. Run ./init.sh, read .harness/long-task/progress.md and the last commits (git log --oneline -10).
2. Take the FIRST feature in .harness/long-task/features.json whose passes is false. If its steps need a feature that is not built yet (a command or page that comes later in the list), build that feature instead this session - the earliest one it needs - and come back to it next session.
3. Build it, with tests.
4. Verify it end to end by following its steps exactly, as a user would (run the program, call the API, use the browser for a UI). Only when every step works, set its passes to true. Never edit ids, descriptions or steps, and never remove a feature or a test.
5. Commit with a message naming the feature, and append one line to the Log in progress.md: the feature, what you did, how you verified it.

One feature only. If the feature cannot be done for any other reason, write why in progress.md and leave passes false.

The goal, for context:
{{input.goal}}

State of the list:
{{feedback}}

fix.title: Fix failing gates
fix.prompt:
The quality gates failed after the last feature. Fix the root causes (not the tests), keep every feature that passed working, and commit.

{{feedback}}

fix-final.title: Fix failing gates
fix-final.prompt:
The quality gates failed. Fix the root causes and commit.

{{feedback}}

review.title: Final review
review.prompt:
Review the finished work against the goal and .harness/long-task/features.json: run ./init.sh, spot-check features end to end, read the code. Write docs/reviews/final-review.md.

<goal>
{{input.goal}}
</goal>

address.title: Address the review
address.prompt:
Address every BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/reviews/final-review.md, with tests, and commit. Note under each finding how it was resolved.

{{state.review}}

fix-final-2.title: Fix failing gates
fix-final-2.prompt:
The quality gates failed. Fix the root causes and commit.

{{feedback}}

stuck.title: Stuck: continue?
stuck.message:
No feature has passed in the last three build sessions. Look at .harness/long-task/progress.md for why. Approve to try again (add guidance in the feedback), or reject to stop. After the third retry without a feature passing, it stops.

{{state.check}}

unstick.title: Reset the stall count (at most three times)
unstick.command: node -e "const f='.harness/long-task/.state.json';const fs=require('fs');let s={};try{s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}catch{}s.stalls=0;s.unsticks=(s.unsticks||0)+1;fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(s));if(s.unsticks>3){console.log('Stuck four times: stopping rather than retrying the same thing again.');process.exit(1)}"

failed.title: Stopped: a step could not be completed
